order.description: The taxonomic order for all records is Ericales.

family.description: Family classification for all records, consistently Polemoniaceae.

species.description: Species name of the recorded plant.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet designating subspecies or variety of Leptosiphon chrysanthus.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded plant, including subspecies and author citations.

countryCode.description: Country code for all records, consistently United States.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

occurrenceStatus.description: Each entry confirms the species presence at the recorded site.

individualCount.description: Individual count data missing for all records.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is unspecified for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier linking each record to a specific species concept.

speciesKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Leptosiphon chrysanthus species records.

basisOfRecord.description: All records are derived from human observations of the species.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for occurrence records, consistently “iNaturalist”.

collectionCode.description: Standard collection code indicating data were gathered through observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record.

typeStatus.description: Type status information is missing for all records.
